title: Fixed-scalar identity-factor evaluation of geometric compact support
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and X, Z, Y Noetherian schemes. Let i:X→Z be a quasi-compact open immersion and p:Z→Y proper. For the compactifications ci=(i,id), cp=(id,p), c=(i,p), the pro-etale compositor of [lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence] at a bounded-below etale object L equals the canonical identity-open unit followed by proper image of the identity-direct-image unit at ν_X^*L. The identity-open unit is obtained by deriving the left-adjoint identity isomorphism; the identity-direct-image unit is rightDerivedLowerStarId. Their pair is identityFactorFixedIso. All functors are ordinary fixed-Λ module sheaf functors of [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]; there is no intrinsic coefficient presentation and no retained finite witness.

proof.text: Use etale_compositor_tower for the triangle with cf=(i,id), cg=(id,p), cfg=(i,p) and both middle maps identity on Z. The canonical changes from a compactification to itself are identity. Identify native_bounded_triangle_iso with the bounded etale formalism compositor. Expand its component, use exchange_id_vert, shComp′_id_right and pfComp′_id_left_inv_app, and cancel the adjacent open identity isomorphism and its inverse. The result is proper image of the open identity unit followed by proper image of the direct-image identity unit. The existing etale_open_id_eq and etale_proper_id_eq identify the formalism units with the specified derived identity maps.

For the identity direct image, use the bounded-below right-derived base-change identity formula. The normalized_identity_compat uniqueness lemma identifies the inclusion of its bounded-below identity map with rightDerivedLowerStarId; the two comparison-inclusion isomorphisms are identities. For the identity open extension, apply the identity clause of finiteSiteWordRefinement, include into the unbounded category by inclusion_square_hom, and identify leftAdjointUniq with leftAdjointIdIso. Thus both primitive comparisons respect the specified identity unit maps. Expand the compact-support boundary by compactComparison_hom, namely the proper direct-image comparison followed by proper image of the open comparison.

Paste those primitive identity equations: naturality of the pro-etale open identity moves the boundary for (i,id) past that identity; naturality of the direct-image identity moves the open comparison past the direct-image unit; naturality of the proper direct-image comparison combines the two etale units. This gives the composition site square with identityFactorFixedIso on its pro-etale side. The normalized composition_site_square supplies the same left side with coherenceProEtaleCompositor. Cancel the invertible source comparison. This calculation is valid for zero complexes and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem identityFactorFixedCompositor (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsProper p] [QuasiCompact i]
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    coherenceProEtaleCompositor Λ (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion i)
        (Compactification.ofIsProper p) (identityFactorPair i p) L =
      (identityFactorFixedIso Λ i p).hom.app ((coherenceBoundedSiteFunctor Λ X).obj L)
